items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: Martha Glaser is identified as the sender of the letter/memoir sharing Slam Stewart's account; no direct interaction or personal relationship between Slam Stewart and Martha Glaser is described in the text.

ctx.x: Erroll always gave me credit for helping him get in the 'big time' but he would have achieved that anyway. I knew the first time I heard him play that he was a giant! I saw Erroll only occasionally over the years but the love and admiration we felt was always there. He was my brother. The unforgettable sound of Erroll Garner will live forever!

Dear Friends;

January 2nd, 1981, will mark the fourth anniversary of the death of Erroll Garner.

Memories of him, both as a man and as an artist, continue with an immediacy; his music remains ever present, ever fresh.

From bassist Slam Stewart, who was Erroll's good friend and performing companion, we have another memoir, which we wish to share with you on this occasion.

We join again with friends in remembrance.

Sincerely,

Martha Glaser
